policy.visible_action_rule: Every visible enabled action must have a working handler, working route, registered helper command, or an explicit disabled/coming-soon reason.
policy.external_write_rule: External sends, publishes, charges, syncs, DNS writes, uploads, credential copies, and access grants require explicit approval and audit evidence.

actions.label: BNA Helper
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the scoped Operations helper drawer.

test.expected_result: Helper context returns scoped tools and no duplicate public helper widget.

actions.label: Save login for child
actions.expected_behavior: Parent can set/reset only their own child's student username/password and sees the child name.

test.expected_result: Parent-scoped endpoint rejects cross-household student IDs.

actions.label: Create automation with helper
actions.expected_behavior: Creates local automation metadata draft only after confirmation.

test.expected_result: Planner maps create automation/billing workflow language to create_automation without external writes.

actions.label: Capture raw intake
actions.expected_behavior: Helper preserves raw natural-language input, parses it into canonical lanes, returns raw ID/counts, and does not echo private raw text.

test.expected_result: Planner maps ramble/goal-mode language to capture_raw_intake and parser returns raw ID/counts.

actions.label: Request watchdog audit
actions.expected_behavior: Helper creates a Codex-owned local-safe watchdog audit task without external writes.

test.expected_result: Planner maps watchdog audit language to run_watchdog_audit.

actions.label: Start a classroom draft
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a first-party provider classroom/community setup draft only.

test.expected_result: No Google Classroom, payment, send, or access grant is performed.

actions.label: API Usage
actions.expected_behavior: Deep-links or switches the provider portal to a feature-flagged API Usage preview with an honest not-instrumented empty state; refresh and browser back must preserve understandable section navigation, and it must not display fabricated requests, token counts, costs, prompts, secrets, or cross-workspace usage.
actions.permission: provider_owner/provider_admin with api_usage_preview or api_usage entitlement

test.expected_result: API Usage nav appears only behind the preview flag/entitlement, shows the honest empty state, supports direct section deep-link/refresh/back behavior, and passes local responsive smoke at 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900 without horizontal overflow.

actions.label: Open provider workspace section
actions.expected_behavior: Switches between provider-scoped workspace sections using the supported provider section graph, updates the same-origin section query state, preserves browser back/refresh behavior, and must not reveal BNA super-admin sections such as Platform Suite, Team/Admin, Accounting, credentials, deployment controls, or other providers.

test.expected_result: Provider navigation buttons are registered, active state is correct, direct links and browser back work, and no super-admin sections are rendered for the provider portal.

actions.label: Open selected portal
actions.expected_behavior: After server-backed password authentication returns chooser_required, each visible destination link opens only the server-provided same-origin redirect_to for an authenticated membership; it must not route by client-trusted workspace keys, grant extra permissions, accept unsafe external returnTo values, or expose credentials, prompts, secrets, or private account data.
actions.permission: authenticated identity with at least one resolved destination

test.expected_result: Operations, provider, student, and parent password login pages render chooser links with this registered action id, use only server-provided redirect_to values, and pass the local responsive chooser smoke at 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900.

actions.label: Start 30 Days Free
actions.expected_behavior: Scrolls to the first-party interest form for a 30-day-free trial request; does not create checkout, send messages, create a Zoom meeting, or grant access.

test.expected_result: Primary CTA points to #signup and no payment, send, Zoom creation, or access grant fires.

actions.label: Watch Rabbi Scheller
actions.expected_behavior: Scrolls to the embedded public Vimeo promo without exposing private member-library videos or TEST review links.

test.expected_result: Secondary CTA targets #watch-rabbi and public page embeds Vimeo 1158542993 only for the public promo.

actions.label: Read Campaign Timer
actions.expected_behavior: Reads /api/one-time/campaign for server time and the configured deadline; if no deadline is configured it shows an operator-decision state instead of a fake reset timer.

test.expected_result: /api/one-time/campaign is read-only and exposes ONE_TIME_CAMPAIGN_DEADLINE_AT dependency without external writes.

actions.label: Request 30-Day Trial
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a first-party OneTime interest lead with explicit consent for review only; no checkout, external send, live charge, or access grant.

test.expected_result: Posts only to /api/one-time/interest after consent and returns a no-checkout/no-send/no-access-grant confirmation.

actions.label: Member Login
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the member login entry shell without exposing private library data to logged-out visitors.

test.expected_result: /rabbi-member or member entry shows safe login shell unless valid scoped member access is present.

actions.label: Start View as Rabbi
actions.expected_behavior: Platform super-admin receives a short-lived signed read-only One Time provider preview URL for Rabbi Elie Scheller only.

test.expected_result: Endpoint requires all-scope admin identity, returns read_only=true, and performs no provider/member write.

actions.label: Exit View as Rabbi
actions.expected_behavior: Ends the local read-only view-as preview session and returns the operator to the normal One Time provider review view.

test.expected_result: Banner exit posts only to /api/bna/one-time/view-as-rabbi/end with the signed token and no provider/member mutation.

actions.label: Submit Question
actions.expected_behavior: Creates an authenticated member-scoped private question review record only; no forum post, member feed, external send, or unrestricted study bot answer.

test.expected_result: POST /api/rabbi/member/questions requires a member session token and returns a sanitized question number without internal notes or source context.

actions.label: Open Ticket
actions.expected_behavior: Creates an authenticated member-scoped support ticket with ticket-only bot metadata; no external notification or cross-member data is returned.

test.expected_result: POST /api/rabbi/member/support-tickets requires a member session token, returns OT-SUP ticket numbers, hides source context/internal notes, and sets unrestricted_mishnah_study_bot=false.

actions.label: Prepare Agent Run
actions.selector_hint: button:contains('Prepare Run'), task agent verification form
actions.expected_behavior: Creates or reuses a scoped bna_agent_runs record, stores the prompt, marks the task verification state ready, and records task/run events.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/tasks/:taskId/agent-runs is Super Admin only and the Operations UI exposes the action only inside the Agents surface/task drawer.

actions.label: Copy Agent Prompt / Open ChatGPT Agent
actions.selector_hint: Copy Agent Prompt, Open ChatGPT Agent
actions.expected_behavior: Copies the scoped prompt locally or opens ChatGPT without production writes, and records a passive copied/opened event on the agent run.

test.expected_result: Progress endpoint treats copied/opened as passive audit events and does not transition the run to running.

actions.label: Post Progress / Attach Evidence
actions.expected_behavior: Records scoped progress and evidence artifacts on the assigned agent run with redaction status; it does not send, publish, delete, charge, or deploy.

test.expected_result: Progress/artifact routes require Super Admin scope and append run events/artifacts.

actions.label: Submit Result / Seal Run
actions.expected_behavior: Requires every criterion to be marked and browser/mixed evidence unless exempt; pass only closes the task when implementation is complete and automated gates passed.

test.expected_result: validateSealPayload enforces summary, criteria, and evidence; task close is gated by implementation_status and automated_gates_passed.

actions.label: Block / Resume / Reopen / Cancel Agent Run
actions.selector_hint: Mark Blocked, Resume, Reopen Fresh Run, Cancel Stale Run
actions.expected_behavior: Moves the run through allowed lifecycle transitions, creates a linked operator decision when blocked, and never mutates production data.

test.expected_result: Lifecycle routes require Super Admin scope, allowed transitions, and append audit events.

actions.label: One Time Agent Status
actions.selector_hint: [data-scoped-agent-status] Refresh, Codex Queue, Open Tasks, Open Task
actions.expected_behavior: Shows scoped One Time machine-work status, queue heartbeat, blockers, and task links for project owner/admin users without exposing Super Admin claim, submit, seal, or production mutation controls.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-operations-ui-smoke.test.js renders [data-scoped-agent-status], verifies One Time tasks, and confirms Claim/Seal controls are absent for scoped users.

actions.label: Preview Drive Brief
actions.expected_behavior: Runs a no-write preview of the latest Rabbi Elie / One Time Drive brief, proves One Time-only scope, displays owner/admin assignments, and lists credential or owner-only blockers.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/project-meetings/one-time-drive-brief/preview returns dry_run=true and Operations exposes only the preview action, not production mutation.

actions.label: Review Checkouts
actions.expected_behavior: Navigates to the Rabbi launch/checkout review panel without creating checkout sessions, payment links, charges, or access grants.

test.expected_result: tests/rabbi-checkout-access.test.js and app:smoke:one-time-payment-access-class-links verify the payment/access panel ships without no-write guardrail regressions.

actions.label: Review Class Links
actions.expected_behavior: Navigates to the live classes review surface without exposing member join URLs or Zoom host/start URLs.

test.expected_result: tests/rabbi-checkout-access.test.js and app:smoke:one-time-payment-access-class-links verify class-link visibility remains relationship scoped.

actions.label: Grant Access
actions.expected_behavior: Remains disabled until an approved local/test payment event and manual admin confirmation exist; this panel never performs a real access grant.
actions.disabled_reason: Requires approved local/test payment event and manual admin confirmation.

test.expected_result: tests/rabbi-checkout-access.test.js and app:smoke:one-time-payment-access-class-links verify automated_access_grants_enabled=false.

actions.label: Reveal Join Link
actions.expected_behavior: Remains disabled until a relationship-scoped protected join reference is approved; raw Zoom join URLs and host/start URLs are never exposed.
actions.disabled_reason: Requires relationship-scoped protected join reference; raw Zoom host/start URLs are never exposed.

test.expected_result: tests/rabbi-checkout-access.test.js and app:smoke:one-time-payment-access-class-links verify raw_zoom_join_url_returned_to_members=false and zoom_host_start_url_returned=false.

actions.label: Platform Suite
actions.selector_hint: ops sidebar/module toolbar Platform Suite navigation
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the mounted Platform UI suite with scoped BNA or One Time fixture data and no external writes.

test.expected_result: Operations platform_suite view mounts [data-platform-ui-root] across desktop and mobile viewports without exposing secret values or live provider mutation controls.

actions.label: Review Auth Matrix
actions.expected_behavior: Navigates to the security/settings context for reviewing the no-write negative authorization matrix.

test.expected_result: Operations renders the action and /api/bna/one-time/test-identities-preview returns TEST-prefixed negative authorization cases.

actions.label: Apply Mock Data
actions.expected_behavior: Disabled preview-only action with a clear setup reason; no production record is created without explicit dry-run/apply authorization.
actions.disabled_reason: Preview only. Apply requires an explicit dry-run cleanup/apply command and TEST-prefix review.

test.expected_result: Button is disabled and the API reports records_created=false and external_write_performed=false.

actions.label: Cleanup TEST Records
actions.expected_behavior: Disabled cleanup action with a clear dry-run requirement and TEST-prefix guard.
actions.disabled_reason: Cleanup is a dry-run manifest only until an operator confirms target TEST records.

test.expected_result: Fixture cleanup_manifest.cleanup_ready is true and requires TEST- prefix.

actions.label: View Agent Status
actions.expected_behavior: Navigates to the Agents overview without starting an external/autonomous agent run.

test.expected_result: Operations renders the action and the acceptance API returns status=pass with no-write flags.

actions.label: View Acceptance Evidence
actions.expected_behavior: Navigates to Codex/Agent work evidence context using existing in-app navigation only.

test.expected_result: Button is present and mapped to switchView/tasks evidence navigation.

actions.label: Run Live Agent Mode
actions.expected_behavior: Disabled with explicit authorization blocker; no autonomous external agent is launched by this batch.
actions.disabled_reason: Read-only acceptance. Running an external/autonomous agent requires explicit operator authorization.

test.expected_result: Button is disabled and the API reports production_mutation_performed=false and external_write_performed=false.

actions.label: Open Source
actions.expected_behavior: Switches the scoped Studio view to the source intake panel without writing data.

test.expected_result: tests/service-provider-studio-browser-smoke.test.js opens Source and saves a mocked local source.

actions.label: Create Project
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a first-party, workspace-scoped Studio project in draft/source state.

test.expected_result: Studio API contract verifies scoped POST route and UI exports createStudioProjectFromForm.

actions.label: Save Source
actions.expected_behavior: Saves raw source privately, returns normalized/hash metadata, and shows only a preview in the UI.

test.expected_result: Domain test verifies unsafe HTML stripping and browser smoke saves a mocked source.

actions.label: Generate Storyboard
actions.expected_behavior: Generates deterministic local storyboard scenes and scene-version rows for the scoped project.

test.expected_result: Domain test validates storyboard output and browser smoke exercises the Storyboard action.

actions.label: Compile Prompt
actions.expected_behavior: Compiles prompt layers with policy, workspace, brief, delimited untrusted source, correction, and no-send output contracts.

test.expected_result: Domain test checks prompt-injection boundaries and browser smoke shows the compiled prompt.

actions.label: Preview Correction
actions.expected_behavior: Previews a reversible correction patch without mutating data or making external calls.

test.expected_result: Correction previews are reversible and no-write; broad patches require confirmation when applied.

actions.label: Apply Preview
actions.expected_behavior: Applies the currently previewed reversible correction patch to the scoped project after confirmation.

test.expected_result: Route enforces scoped project access and broad correction confirmation.

actions.label: Save Scene
actions.expected_behavior: Updates a scoped storyboard scene and appends a scene-version snapshot.

test.expected_result: Scene route loads owner project/workspace before update.

actions.label: Run Mock Render
actions.expected_behavior: Runs a deterministic local mock render, creates local assets/usage, and performs no external write.

test.expected_result: Mock job output has local assets and external_write_performed=false.

actions.label: Create Content Handoff
actions.expected_behavior: Creates an idempotent local Content job/output handoff only; no publish, send, schedule, upload, access grant, payment, or external CRM write.

test.expected_result: Domain test verifies no-publish idempotency and browser smoke creates a mocked local handoff.

actions.label: View One Time as Rabbi
actions.selector_hint: One Time workspace option in the Operations workspace switcher
actions.expected_behavior: Switches the Operations workspace context into the One Time provider view without mutating records or exposing unrelated workspace data.

test.expected_result: Operations workspace taxonomy smoke confirms One Time view is scoped and Super Admin can intentionally switch back.

actions.label: Run One Time member-library smoke
actions.expected_behavior: Runs the bounded member-library smoke only with APPROVE_ONE_TIME_MEMBER_LIBRARY_PUBLISHING and preserves rollback evidence.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-member-library.test.js verifies the exact approval phrase and smoke/rollback path.

actions.label: Preview One Time class package
actions.expected_behavior: Previews the selected One Time class package and linked assets without publishing, sending, billing, Drive/video-host, social, or external CRM writes.

test.expected_result: Preview endpoint returns package data and no external write flags.

actions.label: Preview One Time member visibility
actions.expected_behavior: Shows whether the selected package would be visible for the chosen member tier without changing member-library state.

test.expected_result: Member preview endpoint performs no publish or notification writes.

actions.label: Approve One Time member-library package
actions.expected_behavior: Records internal package approval only when the exact member-library approval phrase is present; it does not publish or notify members.

test.expected_result: Server approve-library route requires APPROVE_ONE_TIME_MEMBER_LIBRARY_PUBLISHING and appends audit evidence.

actions.label: Publish One Time member-library package
actions.expected_behavior: Publishes a member-library item only after explicit destination, tier visibility, and APPROVE_ONE_TIME_MEMBER_LIBRARY_PUBLISHING; previous published item is archived for rollback.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-member-library.test.js verifies approval phrase, member-library readback, and rollback path.

actions.label: Rollback One Time member-library item
actions.expected_behavior: Archives the selected member-library item with a rollback note and keeps the source class package intact.

test.expected_result: Rollback endpoint records archived state and live smoke confirms item no longer appears in member-library readback.

actions.label: Dry-run send live Zoom links
actions.expected_behavior: Calculates eligible/skipped recipients for a One Time live session and returns a summary without sending messages.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/live-sessions/:id/send-zoom-link defaults to dryRun=true and reports no sends.

actions.label: Send live Zoom links
actions.expected_behavior: Sends the current Zoom link only after the explicit Operations confirmation prompt and project-scoped recipient resolution.

test.expected_result: UI requires confirm before dryRun=false; server scopes recipients to the live-session project.

actions.label: Generate parent access code
actions.expected_behavior: Generates or rotates one parent access code only after an explicit confirmation prompt and shows the raw code once.

test.expected_result: Operations UI confirms rotation and server endpoint is admin-only.

actions.label: Open parent portal link
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a short-lived parent portal link and opens it locally; no email or WhatsApp send runs.

test.expected_result: UI calls parent-access/link with send_email=false and send_whatsapp=false for open mode.

actions.label: Email parent portal login link
actions.expected_behavior: Sends one short-lived parent portal login link by email through the admin-only parent access endpoint.

test.expected_result: Single-family email link action stays on explicit per-parent button and is not a bulk campaign.

actions.label: WhatsApp parent portal login link
actions.expected_behavior: Sends one short-lived parent portal login link by WhatsApp only after an explicit confirmation prompt and SEND_WHATSAPP server confirmation token.

test.expected_result: Server rejects WhatsApp sends unless confirm is SEND_WHATSAPP.

actions.label: Preview parent password setup
actions.expected_behavior: Shows the parent password setup/reset email preview with dry_run=true and no email send.

test.expected_result: Password setup endpoint returns dry_run=true, no_send=true, and external_write_performed=false.

actions.label: Email parent password setup
actions.expected_behavior: Sends one password setup/reset email only after the explicit UI confirmation and SEND_PARENT_PASSWORD_SETUP server confirmation token.

test.expected_result: Server rejects non-dry-run password setup unless confirm is SEND_PARENT_PASSWORD_SETUP.

actions.label: Open setup page
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the static credential-safe owner setup center.

test.expected_result: Operations owner setup panel links to /integration-setup.html and the route registry marks it credential-safe.

actions.label: Run validation
actions.expected_behavior: Calls the protected owner setup readiness endpoint and displays success or blocker status without secrets.

test.expected_result: Button calls GET /api/bna/integration-setup/readiness through the Operations API client and performs no external write.
